items.title: Techno Team

items.description: Like right out of a comic strip, save the cubic world dressed as these sharp mechanized robots!

items.title: Red vs Blue Battle Armour
items.creator: MobBlocks
items.description:
The battle has just got serious, time to put on your armour and pick a side.
One free skin!

items.title: Demons HD
items.creator: Fall Studios
items.description:
More demons and this time in HD! New styles and new horns, show your friends your cool new demon look!

+Comes with 1 free skin!
+By FallStudios

items.title: Anime Ninjas 2
items.creator: Fall Studios
items.description:
Train and fight daily to become a great ninja warrior, just like in anime!

+10 skins
+By Street Studios

items.title: Amazing Summer Icons
items.creator: Team Visionary
items.description:
Summer vacation is finally here, you and your friends are ready to breakout and strut your stuff. While adorning the latest trendy fashions, the warm summer breeze blowing through your hair, you can't help but feel the excitement and energy all around you. You and your crew are killing it this summer.

+ 1 free skin
+ 12 skins
+ By Team Visionary

items.title: Street Performers HD
items.creator: BLOCKLAB Studios
items.description:
Ever wanted to show off your awesome magic tricks to your friends? Or maybe you've wanted to impress them with your mime? Well, this is the perfect pack for you!

- Perfect for city roleplay!
- Includes 6 HD skins!
- A range of street performers!
- Published by BLOCKLAB Studios under license from Zander Studios.

items.title: Summer Vibe Teens
items.creator: BLOCKLAB Studios
items.description:
Summer has arrived! Along with it these trendy summer-themed skins. It's getting hot outside! So pick a cool and stylish outfit now!

- 8 skins included
- Published by BLOCKLAB Studios under license from UniDesigns

items.title: Adventure Teens
items.creator: BLOCKLAB Studios
items.description:
Ready, set, explore! Adventure Teens offers the ultimate mix of excitement and adventure all in one awesome skin pack! 

- Join six adventurous teenagers on their journey!
- Packed with mystery and wonder for endless fun!
- Published by BLOCKLAB Studios under license from Meraki Studios.

items.title: Skaters
items.creator: Cynosia
items.description:
Cruise through the city with your friends wearing the newest fashion trends. This skinpack includes clothing for every skater!

+ 10 skins
+ Great for you and your friends!
+ Made by Artifact Studios

items.title: Teen Demon High School Mash-Up
items.creator: GoE-Craft
items.description:
Time to join the teen demons high school! Learn the secrets of magic, sorcery, and enchantments. Tame powerful dragons, perform epic enchantments, and much more. Collect coins and trade them for rare goods.

+ 1,000 clothing combinations
+ Customizable, animated demons
+ Tamable dragons
+ 8 adorable HD skins
+ This mash-up is using the full HD Anime Style texture pack.

items.title: Royal Teens
items.creator: NovaEGG
items.description: Prince and princesses can look their best as well.

items.title: Animal Onesies
items.creator: BLOCKLAB Studios
items.description:
Unleash your spirit animal inside you! You can now represent your favorite animals in these brand new onesies, be it a penguin, a cow, or even a dragon.

- Includes the following animals: dragon, bear, cat, and more!
- Published by BLOCKLAB Studios under license from Levelatics.

items.title: Glitch Demons
items.creator: BLOCKLAB Studios
items.description:
There has been a big glitch in the system and the glitched demons have escaped! Escape as any colorful teen demon skin along with your buddies! What are you waiting for?!

- 8 HQ skins
- Mega awesome
- Published by BLOCKLAB Studios under license from UniDesigns.

items.title: Happy Jeans Teens
items.creator: BLOCKLAB Studios
items.description:
It's time to look your best in jeans! Pick out your favorite outfit and go out to have fun with friends.

- 12 amazing skins
- Perfect for role-playing
- Published by BLOCKLAB Studios under license from Overtales Studio.

items.title: Millionaire's Base Underwater
items.creator: Netherpixel
items.description:
Experience the life of a millionaire in your own luxury underwater base. Discover all the rooms in the house and explore the depths of the sea with your own submarine.

-Your own submarine
-Mansion with lots of rooms
-Chest room
-Farm room
-Two skins

items.title: Luxury Anime
items.creator: Pixelusion
items.description:
Do you like anime? Are you a cool gamer? So show it with these new luxury anime skins and be the coolest player in your favourite servers!
Incarnate your favorite character and show to the world your fashion taste!

- 11 luxury brand anime skins!
- Perfect for role-playing!
- By Pixelusion & SucreGappySan

items.title: A-Lister Lifestyle
items.creator: Netherpixel
items.description:
Teens are back in town! Dazzle up and equip the latest fashion trends. Grab a skin, be one of the most popular teens and head to the city! Look no further and show off your swag!

- Twelve trendy teen skins
- Perfect for role playing

items.title: Royalty Lifestyle
items.creator: Netherpixel
items.description:
Honor is everything! Rule the biomes of Minecraft and immerse yourself with riches beyond your imagination! Experience life as a prince or princess in your own kingdom and turn your dreams into reality! Take your rightful throne and rule the land with elegance. Ready for awesome role-playing?

- Thirteen royal skins
- Perfect for multiplayer

items.title: Vampire Teens
items.creator: Cypress Games
items.description:
The full moon has come. Choose your favorite vampire skin and join the vampire family. Bear in mind, other players may be a little afraid of you.

+ 12 skins
+ 2 free skins
+ Perfect for roleplay
+ Perfect for teens

items.title: Stone Challenge
items.creator: Dig Down Studios
items.description: Can you beat the game when all stone around you is removed? Woah! There are now exposed ores everywhere. However, watch out because the only thing stopping you from a fall to your doom is a thin layer of dirt. In addition, for added difficulty netherrack and end stone disappear as well.

items.title: Bedwars Pros
items.creator: DigiPort
items.description:
Are you a bedwars professional? Do make next level plays? Well! This skin pack is the one for you! If you are a seasoned pro or a PVP noob these skins are sure to make you stand out on the battlefield.

+ 12 modern skins
+ Look stylish while showing off your skills

items.title: Volcano Teens
items.creator: NovaEGG
items.description: Fire is hot, volcanoes are hot, but with these skins, you'll be even hotter.

items.title: ZOO BUILDER
items.creator: Team Workbench
items.description:
Build your dream zoo! Easily place, rotate and remove realistic structures in Zoo Builder. 
Take care of animals and gain more visitors by expanding your zoo. Creative mode had never been so much fun!

+ 21 New Animals 
+ 8 Visitor Skins
+ 2 Buggies
+ Custom Textures

Multiplayer friendly (1-4 players recommended)

items.title: Blan Arena
items.creator: Razzleberries
items.description:
You've found your way to Blan Arena, the place where warriors test their skills against each other. 
Are you the strongest among your friends? Come here to find out!

- Includes a town with custom homes worthy of heroic warriors
- Massive arena where you can battle against your rivals
